subject.title: Webchat: autocomplete/suggestions for custom terms in chat input

question: Should custom-term autocomplete be implemented as part of a shared Control UI composer suggestion model, as a WebChat-local config/source, or deferred until a plugin/draft-suggestion API exists?
rationale: The issue adds new user-facing composer behavior and likely a new persistence/config source, while current docs intentionally avoid persisted WebChat config and adjacent autocomplete requests need the same UX contract.

options.title: Scope a shared composer suggestion model
options.body: Use the existing slash-menu composer path as the starting point and choose a canonical custom-term source that can also support adjacent @agent and draft-assistance work.

options.title: Approve WebChat-local config/source
options.body: Accept a new WebChat-owned source such as config or a workspace file, with docs, schema, doctor implications, and upgrade proof handled explicitly.

options.title: Defer to plugin/API design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers decide whether a plugin or ClawHub package can provide custom dictionaries through a new composer suggestion API.

recommendation.title: Scope a shared composer suggestion model
recommendation.body: Use the existing slash-menu composer path as the starting point and choose a canonical custom-term source that can also support adjacent @agent and draft-assistance work.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned and has already framed the unresolved decision as the composer suggestion contract plus custom-term source.
